source_caption_data.pre_caption: This video presents a grand architectural scenery shot, capturing a massive nighttime celebration at a sprawling, illuminated palace. The symmetrical, multi-story palace, constructed from reddish-brown material with white trim, serves as the backdrop for a long, wide avenue. A vibrant red carpet bisects the avenue, which is filled with a procession of vintage cars and uniformed figures, while large crowds watch from bleachers on either side. The camera pulls back to reveal an ornate, brightly lit gatehouse in the foreground, featuring a red "WELCOME" sign and a British flag on its roof. The festive atmosphere is enhanced by fireworks bursting in the dark sky and the entire scene being bathed in a warm, golden light. There is no single main subject, as the shot's purpose is to convey the immense scale and opulent atmosphere of the event. The focus is on the environment and the grandeur of the spectacle as a whole, rather than any individual component within it.
